function.name: compute
function.description: Run a short Python program (standard library only, no access to the market or the network) and return what it prints, within this turn. One successful run per turn; a failed run gets one more attempt, once per turn. A compute call sent in the same reply as act doesn't run. Example: {"code": "print(2 + 2)"}

code.description: the program, up to 20000 characters; it is stopped after 5 seconds of computing or 10 seconds in all, and the first 4000 characters of its output come back

function.name: act
function.description: End your turn: send up to 6 actions, which run after every participant has ended their turn, and your private memory. Example: {"actions": [{"action": "<action name>", "<argument name>": <value>}, {"action": "<action name>"}], "memory": "<your memory>"}

actions.description: the actions, in order: a list of up to 6 (any beyond the first 6 are dropped), each an object {"action": "<action name>", "<argument name>": <value>}. The list may be empty, [], when you take no action this turn.

memory.description: your private memory, up to 2000 characters (longer is cut), shown in your view at your next turn; it replaces your previous memory, and an empty memory leaves it unchanged
